mrv_findings.text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:9-14 — execute(...)[0]['id'] indexes into a zero-row PG result with no guard; on any DB where embed_category was never set (the default), the category lookup returns 0 rows and nil['id'] raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration (P0, confidence 90).

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:31 — unconditional DELETE FROM site_settings WHERE name IN ('embeddable_hosts','embed_category') at the end of the migration destroys the source data with no backup and no down migration; irreversible data loss if the INSERT step silently mis-migrated data (P0, confidence 95).

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:1-33 — migration uses def change with raw execute() calls (INSERT/DELETE); these are not auto-reversible so rollback raises ActiveRecord::IrreversibleMigration, leaving no way to revert the deploy (P1, confidence 90).

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:23 — execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)" interpolates untrusted/legacy host values directly into SQL with no escaping — SQL injection if any stored host value contains a quote (P1, confidence 75).
db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:24-28 — same raw string interpolation of h into INSERT VALUES is a classic SQL injection pattern with no defense-in-depth (P2, confidence 75).

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:9-13 — category_id resolved via join on site_settings.value = categories.name (string match); any rename/deletion/whitespace mismatch causes execute(...)[0] to be nil and nil['id'] raises, crashing migration on realistic real-world data (P1, confidence 80).

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:9-13 — magic-string join on category name for migration correctness with silent uncategorized fallback and no uniqueness guarantee across categories sharing a name (P2, confidence 70).

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:3 — create_table :embeddable_hosts, force: true drops any pre-existing table on re-run, silently destroying rows created between a failed and re-run migration, with no down to recover (P2, confidence 60).

config/site_settings.yml:759-766 — embeddable_hosts/embed_category settings removed in the same commit whose migration reads them via raw SQL; any code/plugin still referencing SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts or embed_category during a rolling deploy window raises NoMethodError (P2, confidence 60).

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:3-6 — no unique index on host and no FK/index on category_id; duplicate host rows are representable, record_for_host lookups are nondeterministic and unindexed (full scan), and deleting a category leaves dangling embeddable_hosts.category_id (P2, confidence 85).

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:1-24 — no validates_uniqueness_of :host; duplicate/overlapping host rows can map to different categories and record_for_host (.first) resolves ambiguously (P2, confidence 75).

app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:9-18 — no uniqueness validation or locking in create/update; concurrent requests can create two rows for the same host (TOCTOU), producing nondeterministic embed-category resolution (P2, confidence 75).

app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:1-34 — create/update/destroy actions (including category_id fallback to uncategorized) have zero test coverage; spec only asserts subclassing (P1, confidence 100).
app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:1-21 — show/update actions and fetch_embedding (OpenStruct ordering) have zero test coverage; spec only asserts subclassing (P1, confidence 100).

spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb:1-9 — entire spec is a trivial "is a subclass" check; no coverage of create/update/destroy, JSON response, error path, or category_id defaulting (P1, confidence 100).
spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb:1-9 — same trivial-only pattern; show/update never invoked, EmbeddingSerializer output never verified (P1, confidence 100).
spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb and embedding_controller_spec.rb — no test coverage for core CRUD logic (success, validation failure, missing record) (P2, confidence 90).

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-7 — before_validation calls self.host.sub!(...) unconditionally; if host param is nil/missing (e.g. blank "Add Host" flow), nil.sub! raises NoMethodError as an unhandled 500 instead of a validation failure (P1, confidence 80).
app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-7 — same nil-host sub! crash; controller passes params[:embeddable_host][:host] straight through with no presence guard (P2, confidence 75).

app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:11-13 — update fetches host via where(id:).first with no nil-check, then calls save_host(host)/host.host=; a nonexistent id raises NoMethodError instead of returning 404 (P2, confidence 70).
app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:15-17 — destroy has the same nil-record NoMethodError pattern on host.destroy (P3, confidence 75).
app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:16 — host.destroy with no nil-check for a nonexistent id is untested and would raise instead of returning an error response (P2, confidence 75).

config/routes.rb:153 — resources :embeddable_hosts implies index/show routes, but the controller only defines create/update/destroy; hitting index/show will error with unhandled action (P3, confidence 50).

app/models/topic_embed.rb:36-41 — category: eh.try(:category_id) silently passes nil when no EmbeddableHost matches the URL, quietly dropping category assignment where SiteSetting.embed_category previously gave a defined default — a quiet behavior change for embed paths not gated by host validation (P2, confidence 60).

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:14-21 — record_for_host wraps URI(host) in bare rescue nil with no scheme allowlist; reused for TopicEmbed's category-assignment decision and for embed_controller/topic_retriever referer checks — worth deeper review though not confirmed exploitable (P2, confidence 50).

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — where("lower(host) = ?", host) lowercases only the DB column, not the incoming host value; mixed-case referer hosts can fail to match a stored host (P3, confidence 50).

spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb and spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb — file contents are swapped: category_fabricator.rb now defines only Fabricator(:embeddable_host), while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains the :category/:diff_category/:happy_category/:private_category fabricators; functionally harmless (Fabrication loads by directory) but misleads future maintainers searching by filename, and no spec exercises Fabricate(:embeddable_host) (P2, confidence 90-100).
